title: Investigation into Possible Subletting of JTC Premises to 26,000 Business Entities Without JTC's Approval
what_it_is: Investigation into Possible Subletting of JTC Premises to 26,000 Business Entities Without JTC's Approval

sections.label: AGO unauthorised subletting at JTC
sections.summary: AGO's 2020 Report identified 26,000 potential unauthorised subletting instances; JTC is investigating, finding 1,900 deregistered entities and 700 on divested properties.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Auditor-General’s Office (AGO) had, in its 2020 Report, identified 26,000 instances of potential unauthorised subletting because 26,000 business entities had indicated JTC premises as their registered addresses even though they were not JTC’s lessees, tenants or authorised sublessees.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: JTC is investigating the entities highlighted by AGO.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: So far, JTC has found that 1,900 of them are deregistered entities and 700 of them are on divested properties where JTC’s subletting policies do not apply.

sections.label: JTC prioritises remaining entity investigations
sections.summary: 15,000 entities account for around 60% of AGO's highlighted entities, and JTC has prioritised investigations for the remaining 11,000.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Together, if we add them all up, these 15,000 entities account for around 60% of all the entities that AGO has highlighted.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For the remaining 40% of the entities – there are about 11,000 of them – JTC has now prioritised investigations for them.

sections.label: JTC confirmed unauthorised subletting cases
sections.summary: JTC has confirmed around 400 unauthorised subletting cases and will complete investigations by the first half of 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: To date, JTC has confirmed around 400 cases of unauthorised subletting.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: JTC will continue and will complete its investigations by the first half of 2021.

sections.label: Enforcement actions for subletting breaches
sections.summary: Enforcement actions range from financial measures to recover sublet fees to legal action to repossess the site from recalcitrant occupants.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Depending on the severity and circumstances of the breach, enforcement actions will range from financial measures to recover the sublet fees owing to JTC, to legal action to repossess the site from recalcitrant occupants.

sections.label: Balancing enforcement and business encouragement
sections.summary: Measures for the 11,000 entities balance encouraging new businesses with enforcement, including checking address registers and more intense inspections, with about 1,900 inspections in 2019.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Having said that, in terms of the 11,000 that we are now actively looking into, many of the measures that we are taking actually draw a fine balance between taking a proactive step towards encouraging new businesses to start up and to set up and, of course, we need to draw a fine balance between enforcing to make sure that these businesses do not think that every single one that is setting up we treat them as if they are out to game the system itself.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: So, to that end, the measures that we have taken are in terms of looking through the register of addresses, going into frequent and more intense inspection; in 2019, we had conducted about 1,900 inspections.
